title: ACEF Finding Record
description: Payload schema for finding_record records. A reproducible defect observed during testing of a target AI system, with full evidence binding. Distinct from incident_report (operator-facing, single occurrence, post-deployment) by being customer-facing, reproducible, dedupe-tracked, and produced during testing. Cross-vendor concept per brief freddy-on-acef-requirements-v0.1.md §3.3.

finding_class.description: The class of defect this finding describes.

subject_ref.description: URN of the ai_system or ai_model the finding is about.

dedupe_key.description: Stable deduplication hash. NORMATIVE RECIPE (brief §3.3 + design decision D5): dedupe_key = 'sha256:' + hex(SHA-256(JCS-canonicalize({class: finding_class, subject_ref: subject_ref, expected_behavior: reproduction.expected_behavior, reproduction_steps_ref_content_hash: SHA-256-of-content-at-reproduction.reproduction_steps_ref}))). Canonicalization MUST follow RFC 8785 (JCS). Identical recipes across runs MUST collapse to one dedupe_key byte-equal. No hash agility in v0.4 — sha256 only.

variant_group_id.description: Optional URN linking related findings that share a class but differ in surface.

reproduction.description: Reproduction recipe and supporting evidence. All four sub-fields are required and must reference existing artifacts.

expected_behavior.description: Normalized natural-language statement of the expected behavior. Feeds dedupe_key recipe.

reproduction_steps_ref.description: URN or content hash of the reproduction steps artifact. Content of this artifact feeds dedupe_key recipe via SHA-256.

evidence_commit_ref.description: URN of the evidence bundle commit that demonstrates the finding. MUST be present in content-hashes.json or be a fully-qualified external URN referenced by the manifest.

attribution.description: Attribution chain for the finding. Advisory per brief §2.23 but MUST be recorded.

regulation_impact.description: Array of regulation provision IDs (dotted notation as in ACEF Core) this finding may bear on.

discovered_at.description: When the finding was first discovered (ISO 8601).

discovered_in_run_ref.description: URN of the run that produced the finding.

disposition_history.description: Array of URNs pointing to disposition_record variants. The latest disposition does NOT transition the finding's internal state — it is advisory per brief §2.7.

accepted_risk_ref.description: Optional URN of an accepted_risk record if the finding is in accepted-risk state.

regression_ref.description: Optional URN of a regression_definition if a regression has been promoted from this finding.
